q: Can I estimate emissions from the rupee amount of my electricity bill?
title: Carbon per rupee of electricity
short: Only as a rough check. Divide 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh by your all-in cost per kWh: at about ₹8 per kWh that is roughly 0.09 kg per rupee. Fixed charges, demand charges and taxes distort it, so for reporting always use the kWh printed on the bill.

ul: A quick check that a calculated figure is in the right range.
A first estimate before bills are collected, labelled as an estimate.
Bills with high demand or fixed charges.
Months with arrears, rebates or tariff changes.
Sites with rooftop solar netting off imports.

senseible: Senseible reads electricity bills (CEA grid factor 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh, CO2 Baseline Database version 21.0) and diesel, LPG and gas invoices (IPCC 2006 defaults) into a dated, fingerprinted Scope 1 and 2 record for each site, and labels estimates as estimates.
